definitions.explanation: Continuously without rest; working or occurring both day and night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日夜|にちや}⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The researchers are working hard day and night.

examples.japanese: {日夜|にちや}⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けて→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: They continue training day and night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日夜|にちや}⟦{稼働|かどう}→稼働：16938_kadou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The factory operates around the clock.

notes:
{日夜|にちや} emphasizes tireless, continuous effort — working or happening both day and night without pause.

COMPOUND: ⟦{日|にち}→日：noentry⟧ (day) + ⟦{夜|や}→夜：00487_yoru⟧ (night)

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal and literary. In casual speech, ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧ or ⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧ would be more natural.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {日夜|にちや}⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make efforts day and night
- {日夜|にちや}⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to research day and night
- {日夜|にちや}⟦{稼働|かどう}→稼働：16938_kadou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to operate around the clock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{昼夜|ちゅうや}→昼夜：12993_chuuya⟧: day and night (similar meaning, slightly more neutral)
- ⟦{四六時中|しろくじちゅう}→四六時中：19006_shirokujichuu⟧: around the clock, constantly (colloquial)
- ⟦{絶|た}えず→絶えず：15260_taezu⟧: constantly, unceasingly (more formal)
